proposal:
SELECT 
    zoneregistry AS site_code,
    zonelabel AS site_designation,
    CASE presstat 
        WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 5
        WHEN 'Good' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Fair' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Poor' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1
    END AS quality_index
FROM 
    sites
ORDER BY 
    quality_index DESC;
